healthcheck.title: Healthcheck
healthcheck.description: Verify the personal API token with the cheapest authenticated call, query { me { id name email is_guest } } — the exact example monday's own auth docs use. monday can answer HTTP 200 with a populated errors array on an auth failure (this manifest's bodyErrorPaths demotes that to a failure before this ever returns), so on real success this still checks that data.me.id is present rather than trusting the status code alone. Takes no input.

body.query: query { me { id name email is_guest } }

item.create.title: Create Item
item.create.description: Create an item on a board with the create_item mutation. boardId and itemName are the two non-null CreateItem arguments (board_id: ID!, item_name: String!); both are required here for the same reason. columnValues, if given, MUST be a JSON-ENCODED STRING, not an object — e.g. "{\"date\":\"2023-05-25\",\"status\":{\"index\":1}}" — monday's column_values argument is type JSON and accepts a stringified object; sending a real object silently fails the write. groupId places the item in a specific group (defaults to the board's first group); createLabels auto-creates status/dropdown label values referenced in columnValues that do not yet exist.

groupId.description: Group ID to place the item in. Defaults to the board's first group.

columnValues.description: JSON-ENCODED STRING of column id -> value, e.g. "{\"status\":{\"index\":1}}". NOT an object — monday's column_values argument is the JSON scalar, which this connector sends as a stringified payload.

createLabels.description: Create missing status/dropdown label values referenced in columnValues.

body.query: mutation CreateItem($boardId: ID!, $groupId: String, $itemName: String!, $columnValues: JSON, $createLabels: Boolean) { create_item( board_id: $boardId group_id: $groupId item_name: $itemName column_values: $columnValues create_labels_if_missing: $createLabels ) { id name url } }

item.createSubitem.title: Create Subitem
item.createSubitem.description: Create a subitem under a parent item with the create_subitem mutation. parentItemId and itemName are required (parent_item_id: ID!, item_name: String!). columnValues, if given, MUST be a JSON-ENCODED STRING, not an object — same JSON scalar convention as item.create.

columnValues.description: JSON-ENCODED STRING of column id -> value. NOT an object.

body.query: mutation ($parentItemId: ID!, $itemName: String!, $columnValues: JSON) { create_subitem(parent_item_id: $parentItemId, item_name: $itemName, column_values: $columnValues) { id name board { id } } }

item.updateColumnValues.title: Update Item Column Values
item.updateColumnValues.description: Change one or more column values on an item with the change_multiple_column_values mutation. boardId and columnValues are required (board_id: ID!, column_values: JSON!); itemId is nullable in the SDL but should almost always be passed to target the write at a specific item. columnValues MUST be a JSON-ENCODED STRING, not an object — e.g. "{\"status\":{\"index\":1},\"date4\":{\"date\":\"2021-01-01\"}}"; sending a real object silently fails the write. THIS IS ALSO HOW ITEM RENAMING WORKS — monday has no dedicated rename mutation. To rename an item, call this operation with columnValues set to JSON.stringify({ name: "Updated Task Name" }) and itemId set to the item to rename.

boardId.description: Board ID the item belongs to (ID!). Required.

itemId.description: Item ID to update. Nullable in the SDL, but required in practice to target a specific item — including for renaming via the name pseudo-column.

columnValues.description: JSON-ENCODED STRING of column id -> value (JSON!). NOT an object. Use the pseudo-column "name" to rename the item, e.g. "{\"name\":\"Updated Task Name\"}".

createLabels.description: Create missing status/dropdown label values referenced in columnValues.

body.query: mutation ($boardId: ID!, $itemId: ID, $columnValues: JSON!, $createLabels: Boolean) { change_multiple_column_values( board_id: $boardId item_id: $itemId column_values: $columnValues create_labels_if_missing: $createLabels ) { id name } }

item.get.title: Get Items
item.get.description: Fetch items by ID with the items(ids:) query. ids is required — without it the call returns nothing meaningful. Not paginated; pass at most 100 ids per monday's documented per-query item cap.

body.query: query ($ids: [ID!]) { items(ids: $ids) { id name url created_at group { id title } board { id name } } }

item.listByBoard.title: List Items By Board (cursor pagination)
item.listByBoard.description: List a board's items with boards { items_page(limit, cursor) }, the CURSOR-paginated mechanism monday uses for items. boardId is required. limit is required too, even though the brief's own summary table does not list it: the query pins $limit: Int! as a non-null GraphQL variable, and the declarative engine drops an unresolved placeholder rather than defaulting it, so an omitted limit would send a request missing a required variable and monday would reject the whole call. Pass 25 for the documented provider default (max 500). This operation returns items_page.cursor (as nextCursor) for the FIRST page only; for page 2..N call item.nextPage passing that value as its cursor input — do NOT re-call this operation, since re-nesting items_page under boards on every page burns unnecessary complexity budget (monday's own guidance). A null or absent nextCursor in the response means there is no next page.

limit.description: Page size (Int!, required by the query). Provider default 25, max 500.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor. Omit for the first page.

body.query: query ($boardId: ID!, $limit: Int!, $cursor: String) { boards(ids: [$boardId]) { items_page(limit: $limit, cursor: $cursor) { cursor items { id name url column_values { id text value } } } } }

item.nextPage.title: Next Items Page (cursor pagination)
item.nextPage.description: Fetch page 2..N of a cursor-paginated item listing with next_items_page(cursor:), called AT THE QUERY ROOT rather than re-nested under boards { items_page } — monday documents this explicitly as avoiding the complexity cost of re-nesting. cursor is required and comes from a previous item.listByBoard or item.nextPage call's nextCursor result field. A null or absent nextCursor in the response means there is no further page — stop paging.

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous page's nextCursor result (String!). Required.

body.query: query ($cursor: String!) { next_items_page(cursor: $cursor) { cursor items { id name url } } }

update.create.title: Create Update
update.create.description: Post an update (monday's term for a comment/activity note) with the create_update mutation. body is required (String!). itemId is not required if parentId is given (a reply to an existing update); pass itemId to post directly on an item.

itemId.description: Item ID to post the update on. Not required if parentId is given.

parentId.description: Parent update ID, to reply to an existing update thread.

body.query: mutation ($itemId: ID, $body: String!, $parentId: ID) { create_update(item_id: $itemId, body: $body, parent_id: $parentId) { id body created_at } }

update.list.title: List Updates (page pagination)
update.list.description: List recent updates with the updates query, reverse-chronological. Uses the PAGE-NUMBER pagination mechanism (limit + 1-based page), not a cursor — monday's own docs group updates with boards/users/teams under this mechanism. There is no cursor and no total-count field; terminate paging when a page returns fewer results than limit. fromDate/toDate filter by created_at (YYYY-MM-DD).

page.description: 1-based page number. No cursor and no total; stop when a page returns fewer than limit.

body.query: query ($limit: Int, $page: Int, $fromDate: String, $toDate: String) { updates(limit: $limit, page: $page, from_date: $fromDate, to_date: $toDate) { id body created_at creator { id name } } }

board.create.title: Create Board
board.create.description: Create a board with the create_board mutation. boardName and boardKind are required (board_name: String!, board_kind: BoardKind!, one of "private" | "public" | "share"). This intentionally requests only id name on the create payload — whether create_board returns a url field is UNVERIFIED across API versions, so this connector does not map one. To get a board's URL, follow up with board.list filtered to the new id, or a dedicated boards(ids:){url} query.

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID to create the board in.

folderId.description: Folder ID to create the board in.

body.query: mutation ($boardName: String!, $boardKind: BoardKind!, $workspaceId: ID, $folderId: ID, $description: String) { create_board( board_name: $boardName board_kind: $boardKind workspace_id: $workspaceId folder_id: $folderId description: $description ) { id name } }

board.list.title: List Boards (page pagination)
board.list.description: List boards with the boards(limit, page, workspace_ids:) query. Uses the PAGE-NUMBER pagination mechanism (limit + 1-based page) — different from item.listByBoard's cursor mechanism. There is no cursor and no total-count field; terminate paging when a page returns fewer results than limit.

page.description: 1-based page number. No cursor and no total; stop when a page returns fewer than limit.

body.query: query ($limit: Int, $page: Int, $workspaceIds: [ID]) { boards(limit: $limit, page: $page, workspace_ids: $workspaceIds) { id name state permissions } }

group.create.title: Create Group
group.create.description: Create a group on a board with the create_group mutation. boardId and groupName are required (board_id: ID!, group_name: String!, at most 255 chars). groupColor is a HEX string (e.g. "#ff642e"). pos is the position_relative_method enum (before_at | after_at), used together with relativeTo to place the new group.

relativeTo.description: Group ID to position relative to.

pos.description: position_relative_method — where to place the group relative to relativeTo.

body.query: mutation ($boardId: ID!, $groupName: String!, $groupColor: String, $relativeTo: String, $pos: PositionRelative) { create_group( board_id: $boardId group_name: $groupName group_color: $groupColor relative_to: $relativeTo position_relative_method: $pos ) { id } }

group.list.title: List Groups
group.list.description: List a board's groups with boards { groups }. boardId is required. Not paginated — a board's group list is small and returned in full.

body.query: query ($boardId: ID!) { boards(ids: $boardId) { groups { id title color position archived } } }

boards.get.title: Get Boards
boards.get.description: Fetch boards by ID with the boards(ids:) query. ids is required. Returns board metadata, groups, and columns.

body.query: query ($ids: [ID!]) { boards(ids: $ids) { id name state permissions description url workspace { id name } groups { id title } columns { id title type } } }

items.update.title: Update Item
items.update.description: Update an item's column values, including the name pseudo-column, with change_multiple_column_values. boardId, itemId, and columnValues are required. columnValues MUST be a JSON-ENCODED STRING, not an object.

boardId.description: Board ID the item belongs to (ID!). Required.

columnValues.description: JSON-ENCODED STRING of column id -> value (JSON!). NOT an object. Use the pseudo-column "name" to rename the item.

createLabels.description: Create missing status/dropdown label values referenced in columnValues.

body.query: mutation ($boardId: ID!, $itemId: ID!, $columnValues: JSON!, $createLabels: Boolean) { change_multiple_column_values( board_id: $boardId item_id: $itemId column_values: $columnValues create_labels_if_missing: $createLabels ) { id name } }

items.delete.title: Delete Item
items.delete.description: Delete an item with the delete_item mutation. itemId is required (item_id: ID!).

body.query: mutation ($itemId: ID!) { delete_item(item_id: $itemId) { id } }

items.duplicate.title: Duplicate Item
items.duplicate.description: Duplicate an item onto the same board with the duplicate_item mutation. boardId and itemId are required. withUpdates copies the item's updates/comments onto the copy.

boardId.description: Board ID the item belongs to (ID!). Required.

withUpdates.description: Copy the item's updates onto the duplicate.

body.query: mutation ($boardId: ID!, $itemId: ID!, $withUpdates: Boolean) { duplicate_item(board_id: $boardId, item_id: $itemId, with_updates: $withUpdates) { id name } }

columns.change_value.title: Change Column Value
columns.change_value.description: Change a single column value on an item with the change_column_value mutation. boardId, itemId, columnId, and value are required. value MUST be a JSON-ENCODED STRING, not an object — e.g. "{\"index\":1}".

boardId.description: Board ID the item belongs to (ID!). Required.

value.description: JSON-ENCODED STRING of the new column value (JSON!). NOT an object.

body.query: mutation ($boardId: ID!, $itemId: ID!, $columnId: String!, $value: JSON!) { change_column_value(board_id: $boardId, item_id: $itemId, column_id: $columnId, value: $value) { id name } }

webhook.item_created.title: Item Created
webhook.item_created.description: Fires when an item is created on a board.

webhook.item_updated.title: Item Updated
webhook.item_updated.description: Fires when an item is updated on a board.

webhook.board_created.title: Board Created
webhook.board_created.description: Fires when a board is created.

me.get.title: Get Me
me.get.description: Fetch the authenticated monday.com user with query { me { id name email is_guest enabled created_at account { id name slug tier } } }. Takes no input. Distinct from healthcheck: this returns the raw user payload instead of a connector status envelope.

body.query: query { me { id name email is_guest enabled created_at account { id name slug tier } } }

account.get.title: Get Account Info
account.get.description: Fetch the monday.com account for the current token with query { account { id name slug tier } }. Takes no input.

body.query: query { account { id name slug tier } }

complexity.getQuery.title: Get Query Complexity
complexity.getQuery.description: Read remaining GraphQL query complexity budget with query { complexity { query before after } }. Takes no input.

body.query: query { complexity { query before after } }

complexity.getMutation.title: Get Mutation Complexity
complexity.getMutation.description: Read remaining GraphQL mutation complexity budget with query { complexity { mutation before after } }. Takes no input.

body.query: query { complexity { mutation before after } }

versions.list.title: Get Versions
versions.list.description: List monday.com API versions with query { versions { kind value display_name } }. Takes no input.

body.query: query { versions { kind value display_name } }

app.subscription.title: Get App Subscription
app.subscription.description: Retrieve the current app subscription with query { app_subscription { plan_id is_trial days_left billing_period } }. Must be called with an app token. Takes no input.

body.query: query { app_subscription { plan_id is_trial days_left billing_period } }

users.list.title: List Users
users.list.description: List monday.com users with the users(ids, emails, name, kind, limit, page) query. Page-number pagination (limit + 1-based page). Stop when a page returns fewer than limit.

body.query: query ($ids: [ID!], $emails: [String], $name: String, $kind: UserKind, $limit: Int, $page: Int) { users(ids: $ids, emails: $emails, name: $name, kind: $kind, limit: $limit, page: $page) { id name email enabled is_guest created_at title } }

users.activate.title: Activate Users
users.activate.description: Activate or reactivate users with the activate_users mutation. userIds is required ([ID!]!, max 200). Cannot activate your own account. Requires account management permissions.

userIds.description: User IDs to activate. Required. Max 200.

body.query: mutation ($userIds: [ID!]!) { activate_users(user_ids: $userIds) { activated_users { id name email enabled } errors { user_id code message } } }

users.deactivate.title: Deactivate Users
users.deactivate.description: Deactivate users with the deactivate_users mutation. userIds is required ([ID!]!, max 200). Cannot deactivate yourself. Requires admin permissions.

userIds.description: User IDs to deactivate. Required. Max 200.

body.query: mutation ($userIds: [ID!]!) { deactivate_users(user_ids: $userIds) { deactivated_users { id name email enabled } errors { user_id code message } } }

users.create.title: Invite Users
users.create.description: Invite users into the account with the invite_users mutation. emails is required ([String!]!). userRole is a UserRole enum (admin, guest, member, view_only). product selects the account product.

body.query: mutation ($emails: [String!]!, $userRole: UserRole, $product: String) { invite_users(emails: $emails, user_role: $userRole, product: $product) { invited_users { id name email } errors { email message } } }

users.updateRole.title: Update Users Role
users.updateRole.description: Change users' roles with the update_users_role mutation. userIds is required. Pass newRole (UserRole) and/or roleId (custom enterprise role). Cannot update your own role.

userIds.description: User IDs whose role will change. Required. Max 200.

body.query: mutation ($userIds: [ID!]!, $newRole: UserRole, $roleId: ID) { update_users_role(user_ids: $userIds, new_role: $newRole, role_id: $roleId) { successful_users { id name email } failed_users { id name email } } }

workspace.list.title: Get Workspaces
workspace.list.description: List workspaces with the workspaces(ids, kind, limit, page, state, order_by) query. Page-number pagination. kind is WorkspaceKind (open, closed, template); state is State (active, archived, deleted, all).

body.query: query ($ids: [ID!], $kind: WorkspaceKind, $limit: Int, $page: Int, $state: State, $orderBy: WorkspacesOrderBy) { workspaces(ids: $ids, kind: $kind, limit: $limit, page: $page, state: $state, order_by: $orderBy) { id name kind state description } }

workspace.create.title: Create Workspace
workspace.create.description: Create a workspace with the create_workspace mutation. name and kind are required (kind: WorkspaceKind open | closed).

accountProductId.description: Account product ID to create the workspace under.

body.query: mutation ($name: String!, $kind: WorkspaceKind!, $description: String, $accountProductId: ID) { create_workspace(name: $name, kind: $kind, description: $description, account_product_id: $accountProductId) { id name kind state description } }

workspace.update.title: Update Workspace
workspace.update.description: Update a workspace with the update_workspace mutation. workspaceId is required. attributes are sent as UpdateWorkspaceAttributesInput (name, description, kind, account_product_id).

accountProductId.description: Account product ID to move the workspace under.

body.query: mutation ($workspaceId: ID!, $attributes: UpdateWorkspaceAttributesInput!) { update_workspace(id: $workspaceId, attributes: $attributes) { id name kind state description } }

workspace.delete.title: Delete Workspace
workspace.delete.description: Delete a workspace with the delete_workspace mutation. workspaceId is required (workspace_id: ID!).

body.query: mutation ($workspaceId: ID!) { delete_workspace(workspace_id: $workspaceId) { id } }

workspace.addUsers.title: Add Users To Workspace
workspace.addUsers.description: Add users to a workspace with the add_users_to_workspace mutation. workspaceId and userIds are required. kind is BoardSubscriberKind (owner | subscriber).

body.query: mutation ($workspaceId: ID!, $userIds: [ID!]!, $kind: WorkspaceSubscriberKind) { add_users_to_workspace(workspace_id: $workspaceId, user_ids: $userIds, kind: $kind) { id } }

workspace.removeUsers.title: Remove Users From Workspace
workspace.removeUsers.description: Remove users from a workspace with the delete_users_from_workspace mutation. workspaceId and userIds are required.

body.query: mutation ($workspaceId: ID!, $userIds: [ID!]!) { delete_users_from_workspace(workspace_id: $workspaceId, user_ids: $userIds) { id } }

workspace.removeTeams.title: Delete Teams From Workspace
workspace.removeTeams.description: Remove teams from a workspace with the delete_teams_from_workspace mutation. workspaceId and teamIds are required.

body.query: mutation ($workspaceId: ID!, $teamIds: [ID!]!) { delete_teams_from_workspace(workspace_id: $workspaceId, team_ids: $teamIds) { id } }

board.archive.title: Archive Board
board.archive.description: Archive a board with the archive_board mutation. boardId is required (board_id: ID!). Archived boards can be restored later in monday.com.

body.query: mutation ($boardId: ID!) { archive_board(board_id: $boardId) { id name state } }

board.delete.title: Delete Board
board.delete.description: Delete a board with the delete_board mutation. boardId is required (board_id: ID!). This permanently deletes the board.

body.query: mutation ($boardId: ID!) { delete_board(board_id: $boardId) { id } }

board.duplicate.title: Duplicate Board
board.duplicate.description: Duplicate a board with the duplicate_board mutation. boardId and duplicateType are required. duplicateType is DuplicateBoardType: duplicate_board_with_structure | duplicate_board_with_pulses | duplicate_board_with_pulses_and_updates.

keepSubscribers.description: Keep board subscribers on the copy.

body.query: mutation ($boardId: ID!, $duplicateType: DuplicateBoardType!, $boardName: String, $workspaceId: ID, $folderId: ID, $keepSubscribers: Boolean) { duplicate_board(board_id: $boardId, duplicate_type: $duplicateType, board_name: $boardName, workspace_id: $workspaceId, folder_id: $folderId, keep_subscribers: $keepSubscribers) { board { id name } } }

board.update.title: Update Board
board.update.description: Update a board attribute with the update_board mutation. boardId, boardAttribute, and newValue are required. boardAttribute is BoardAttributes (name, description, communication, item_nickname). Returns a String confirmation.

body.query: mutation ($boardId: ID!, $boardAttribute: BoardAttributes!, $newValue: String!) { update_board(board_id: $boardId, board_attribute: $boardAttribute, new_value: $newValue) }

board.addUsers.title: Add Users To Board
board.addUsers.description: Add users to a board with the add_users_to_board mutation. boardId and userIds are required. kind is BoardSubscriberKind (owner | subscriber).

body.query: mutation ($boardId: ID!, $userIds: [ID!]!, $kind: BoardSubscriberKind) { add_users_to_board(board_id: $boardId, user_ids: $userIds, kind: $kind) { id name email } }

board.addSubscribers.title: Add Subscribers To Board
board.addSubscribers.description: Add subscribers to a board with the deprecated add_subscribers_to_board mutation. Prefer board.addUsers (add_users_to_board). boardId and userIds are required. kind is owner | subscriber.

userIds.description: User IDs to add as subscribers. Required.

body.query: mutation ($boardId: ID!, $userIds: [ID!]!, $kind: BoardSubscriberKind) { add_subscribers_to_board(board_id: $boardId, user_ids: $userIds, kind: $kind) { id name email } }

board.addTeams.title: Add Teams To Board
board.addTeams.description: Add teams to a board with the add_teams_to_board mutation. boardId and teamIds are required. kind is owner | subscriber. Pass team ID -1 to subscribe all account members.

teamIds.description: Team IDs to add. Required. Use -1 for all account members.

body.query: mutation ($boardId: ID!, $teamIds: [ID!]!, $kind: BoardSubscriberKind) { add_teams_to_board(board_id: $boardId, team_ids: $teamIds, kind: $kind) { id name } }

board.removeSubscribers.title: Delete Subscribers From Board
board.removeSubscribers.description: Remove user subscribers from a board with the delete_subscribers_from_board mutation. boardId and userIds are required.

body.query: mutation ($boardId: ID!, $userIds: [ID!]!) { delete_subscribers_from_board(board_id: $boardId, user_ids: $userIds) { id name email } }

board.removeTeams.title: Delete Teams From Board
board.removeTeams.description: Remove teams from a board with the delete_teams_from_board mutation. boardId and teamIds are required.

body.query: mutation ($boardId: ID!, $teamIds: [ID!]!) { delete_teams_from_board(board_id: $boardId, team_ids: $teamIds) { id name } }

board.views.title: Get Board Views
board.views.description: List a board's views with boards { views { id name type } }. boardId is required.

body.query: query ($boardId: ID!) { boards(ids: [$boardId]) { id views { id name type } } }

board.activityLogs.title: Get Activity Logs
board.activityLogs.description: List a board's activity logs with boards { activity_logs(from, to, limit, page, user_ids, item_ids, group_ids, column_ids) }. boardId is required. from/to are ISO8601DateTime.

body.query: query ($boardId: ID!, $from: ISO8601DateTime, $to: ISO8601DateTime, $limit: Int, $page: Int, $userIds: [ID!], $itemIds: [ID!], $groupIds: [String], $columnIds: [String]) { boards(ids: [$boardId]) { id activity_logs(from: $from, to: $to, limit: $limit, page: $page, user_ids: $userIds, item_ids: $itemIds, group_ids: $groupIds, column_ids: $columnIds) { id event entity data user_id account_id created_at } } }

board.muteSettings.title: Query Board Mute Settings
board.muteSettings.description: Read a board's notification mute settings via boards { mute_board_settings }. boardIds is required.

body.query: query ($boardIds: [ID!]!) { boards(ids: $boardIds) { id mute_board_settings } }

board.updateMuteSettings.title: Update Mute Board Settings
board.updateMuteSettings.description: Update a board's notification mute settings with the update_mute_board_settings mutation. boardId and muteState are required. muteState: CURRENT_USER_MUTE_ALL | CUSTOM_SETTINGS | MENTIONS_AND_ASSIGNS_ONLY | MUTE_ALL | NOT_MUTED.

enabled.description: Custom notification settings when muteState is CUSTOM_SETTINGS.

body.query: mutation ($boardId: ID!, $muteState: String!, $enabled: [String]) { update_mute_board_settings(board_id: $boardId, mute_state: $muteState, enabled: $enabled) { id } }

board.setPermission.title: Set Board Permission
board.setPermission.description: Set a board's default role with the set_board_permission mutation. boardId and basicRoleName are required (contributor | editor | viewer). Enterprise; board owners only.

body.query: mutation ($boardId: ID!, $basicRoleName: String!) { set_board_permission(board_id: $boardId, basic_role_name: $basicRoleName) { id permissions } }

board.convertToProject.title: Convert Board To Project
board.convertToProject.description: Convert a board into a project board with the convert_board_to_project mutation. boardId and columnMappings are required. columnMappings MUST be a JSON-ENCODED STRING of status/timeline/owner column mappings.

columnMappings.description: JSON-ENCODED STRING of project column mappings (JSON!). Required.

body.query: mutation ($boardId: ID!, $columnMappings: JSON!) { convert_board_to_project(board_id: $boardId, column_mappings: $columnMappings) { id name } }

board.connectToPortfolio.title: Connect Project To Portfolio
board.connectToPortfolio.description: Link a project board to a portfolio board with the connect_project_to_portfolio mutation. projectBoardId and portfolioBoardId are required. Enterprise; boards:write.

body.query: mutation ($projectBoardId: ID!, $portfolioBoardId: ID!) { connect_project_to_portfolio(project_board_id: $projectBoardId, portfolio_board_id: $portfolioBoardId) { id } }

board.updateHierarchy.title: Update Board Hierarchy
board.updateHierarchy.description: Update a board's hierarchy type with the update_board_hierarchy mutation. boardId is required.

body.query: mutation ($boardId: ID!, $hierarchyType: String) { update_board_hierarchy(board_id: $boardId, hierarchy_type: $hierarchyType) { id } }

boards.connectionIds.title: Get Connection Board IDs
boards.connectionIds.description: Discover board_relation (connect boards) columns and their linked board IDs with boards { columns { id type settings } }. Optionally pass boardIds; otherwise page with limit.

limit.description: Max boards to scan when boardIds is omitted. Default 25.

body.query: query ($boardIds: [ID!], $limit: Int) { boards(ids: $boardIds, limit: $limit) { id name columns { id title type settings } } }

columns.list.title: List Columns
columns.list.description: List a board's columns with boards { columns }. boardId is required. Deprecated Composio name MONDAY_LIST_COLUMNS; prefer columns.get for multi-board filters.

body.query: query ($boardId: ID!) { boards(ids: [$boardId]) { id columns { id title type description archived settings } } }

columns.get.title: Get Board Columns
columns.get.description: Retrieve column metadata from one or more boards with boards(ids:) { columns(ids:, types:) }. boardIds is required.

body.query: query ($boardIds: [ID!]!, $columnIds: [String], $columnTypes: [ColumnType]) { boards(ids: $boardIds) { id columns(ids: $columnIds, types: $columnTypes) { id title type description archived settings } } }

columns.changeSimpleValue.title: Change Simple Column Value
columns.changeSimpleValue.description: Change a column using the change_simple_column_value mutation, which takes a plain string (not a JSON object). boardId, itemId, columnId, and value are required. Suitable for Text, Status, and Dropdown columns. createLabels creates missing status/dropdown labels.

value.description: Simple string value (String!). Required. Status: label name or index as string. Dropdown: label name. Text: plain text.

body.query: mutation ($boardId: ID!, $itemId: ID!, $columnId: String!, $value: String!, $createLabels: Boolean) { change_simple_column_value(board_id: $boardId, item_id: $itemId, column_id: $columnId, value: $value, create_labels_if_missing: $createLabels) { id name } }

column.create.title: Create Column
column.create.description: Create a column with the create_column mutation. boardId, title, and columnType are required. columnType is ColumnType (status, text, long_text, numbers, date, dropdown, people, ...). defaults is a JSON string of column settings. afterColumnId inserts after an existing column.

columnType.description: ColumnType enum token in snake_case (ColumnType!). Required.

body.query: mutation ($boardId: ID!, $title: String!, $columnType: ColumnType!, $description: String, $defaults: JSON, $afterColumnId: String, $id: String) { create_column(board_id: $boardId, title: $title, column_type: $columnType, description: $description, defaults: $defaults, after_column_id: $afterColumnId, id: $id) { id title type description } }

column.update.title: Update Column
column.update.description: Update a column with the update_column mutation. boardId, id, revision, and columnType are required. Optional title, description, width.

body.query: mutation ($boardId: ID!, $id: String!, $revision: String!, $columnType: ColumnType!, $title: String, $description: String, $width: Int) { update_column(board_id: $boardId, id: $id, revision: $revision, column_type: $columnType, title: $title, description: $description, width: $width) { id title type description revision width } }

column.delete.title: Delete Column
column.delete.description: Delete a column with the delete_column mutation. boardId and columnId are required.

body.query: mutation ($boardId: ID!, $columnId: String!) { delete_column(board_id: $boardId, column_id: $columnId) { id } }

views.schema.title: Get View Schema By Type
views.schema.description: Fetch the JSON schema for a column type with get_column_type_schema(type:). columnType is required (ColumnType!).

body.query: query ($columnType: ColumnType!) { get_column_type_schema(type: $columnType) }

group.update.title: Update Group
group.update.description: Update a group attribute with the update_group mutation. boardId, groupId, groupAttribute, and newValue are required. groupAttribute is GroupAttributes: color | position | relative_position_after | relative_position_before | title.

body.query: mutation ($boardId: ID!, $groupId: String!, $groupAttribute: GroupAttributes!, $newValue: String!) { update_group(board_id: $boardId, group_id: $groupId, group_attribute: $groupAttribute, new_value: $newValue) { id title color position } }

group.delete.title: Delete Group
group.delete.description: Delete a group with the delete_group mutation. boardId and groupId are required.

body.query: mutation ($boardId: ID!, $groupId: String!) { delete_group(board_id: $boardId, group_id: $groupId) { id } }

sprints.list.title: Query Sprints
sprints.list.description: Query sprint groups on sprint boards via boards { groups }. boardIds is required. Optional groupIds (sprint IDs) filters the groups. Sprints are implemented as groups on sprint boards.

body.query: query ($boardIds: [ID!]!, $groupIds: [String]) { boards(ids: $boardIds) { id name groups(ids: $groupIds) { id title color position archived } } }

item.archive.title: Archive Item
item.archive.description: Archive an item with the archive_item mutation. itemId is required (item_id: ID!).

body.query: mutation ($itemId: ID!) { archive_item(item_id: $itemId) { id } }

item.moveToGroup.title: Move Item To Group
item.moveToGroup.description: Move an item to another group on the same board with the move_item_to_group mutation. itemId and groupId are required.

body.query: mutation ($itemId: ID!, $groupId: String!) { move_item_to_group(item_id: $itemId, group_id: $groupId) { id name group { id title } } }

item.moveToBoard.title: Move Item To Board
item.moveToBoard.description: Move an item to another board with the move_item_to_board mutation. itemId, boardId, and groupId are required. Optional columnsMapping / subitemsColumnsMapping are [ColumnMappingInput!] objects { source, target }.

body.query: mutation ($itemId: ID!, $boardId: ID!, $groupId: ID!, $columnsMapping: [ColumnMappingInput!], $subitemsColumnsMapping: [ColumnMappingInput!]) { move_item_to_board(item_id: $itemId, board_id: $boardId, group_id: $groupId, columns_mapping: $columnsMapping, subitems_columns_mapping: $subitemsColumnsMapping) { id name board { id } } }

items.list.title: List Items
items.list.description: Fetch items (including subitems) by ID with items(ids:). itemIds is required. Distinct from item.get only by the Composio parameter name item_ids; both hit the items query.

body.query: query ($itemIds: [ID!]!) { items(ids: $itemIds) { id name url created_at parent_item { id name } group { id title } board { id name } column_values { id text type value } } }

items.listByColumnValues.title: List Items By Column Values
items.listByColumnValues.description: Search a board's items with items_page_by_column_values. boardId and limit are required (limit: Int!). columns is [ItemsPageByColumnValuesQuery!] of { column_id, column_values }. Pass cursor to continue paging.

columns.description: Column filters { column_id, column_values }. Required unless paging with cursor.

body.query: query ($boardId: ID!, $limit: Int!, $columns: [ItemsPageByColumnValuesQuery!], $cursor: String) { items_page_by_column_values(board_id: $boardId, limit: $limit, columns: $columns, cursor: $cursor) { cursor items { id name column_values { id text value } } } }

items.listSubitems.title: List Subitems By Parent
items.listSubitems.description: List subitems nested under parent items with items(ids:) { subitems { ... } }. parentItemIds is required.

body.query: query ($parentItemIds: [ID!]!) { items(ids: $parentItemIds) { id name subitems { id name url column_values { id text value } } } }

teams.list.title: Get Teams
teams.list.description: List teams with the teams(ids:) query. Optional ids filters to specific teams.

body.query: query ($ids: [ID!]) { teams(ids: $ids) { id name picture_url } }

team.members.title: List Team Members
team.members.description: List users in a team with teams(ids:) { users }. teamId is required.

body.query: query ($teamId: ID!) { teams(ids: [$teamId]) { id name users { id name email enabled is_guest } } }

team.addUsers.title: Add Users To Team
team.addUsers.description: Add users to a team with the add_users_to_team mutation. teamId and userIds are required. Returns successful_users and failed_users.

body.query: mutation ($teamId: ID!, $userIds: [ID!]!) { add_users_to_team(team_id: $teamId, user_ids: $userIds) { successful_users { id name email } failed_users { id name email } } }

team.removeUsers.title: Remove Users From Team
team.removeUsers.description: Remove users from a team with the delete_users_from_team mutation. teamId and userIds are required.

body.query: mutation ($teamId: ID!, $userIds: [ID!]!) { delete_users_from_team(team_id: $teamId, user_ids: $userIds) { successful_users { id name email } failed_users { id name email } } }

update.edit.title: Edit Update
update.edit.description: Edit an update with the edit_update mutation. id and body are required (id: ID!, body: String!).

body.query: mutation ($id: ID!, $body: String!) { edit_update(id: $id, body: $body) { id body created_at edited_at } }

update.delete.title: Delete Update
update.delete.description: Delete an update with the delete_update mutation. id is required (id: ID!).

body.query: mutation ($id: ID!) { delete_update(id: $id) { id } }

update.like.title: Like Update
update.like.description: Like an update with the like_update mutation. updateId is required (update_id: ID!).

body.query: mutation ($updateId: ID!) { like_update(update_id: $updateId) { id } }

update.unlike.title: Unlike Update
update.unlike.description: Remove a like from an update with the unlike_update mutation. updateId is required (update_id: ID!).

body.query: mutation ($updateId: ID!) { unlike_update(update_id: $updateId) { id } }

update.pin.title: Pin Update To Top
update.pin.description: Pin an update to the top of an item with the pin_to_top mutation. id is required (the update ID). Optional itemId.

itemId.description: Item ID the update belongs to.

body.query: mutation ($id: ID!, $itemId: ID) { pin_to_top(id: $id, item_id: $itemId) { id body } }

update.unpin.title: Unpin Update From Top
update.unpin.description: Unpin an update from the top of an item with the unpin_from_top mutation. id is required. Optional itemId.

itemId.description: Item ID the update belongs to.

body.query: mutation ($id: ID!, $itemId: ID) { unpin_from_top(id: $id, item_id: $itemId) { id body } }

update.replies.title: Get Update Replies
update.replies.description: List replies on one or more boards with the replies(board_ids, limit, page) query. boardIds is required.

boardIds.description: Board IDs whose update replies to list. Required.

body.query: query ($boardIds: [ID!]!, $limit: Int, $page: Int) { replies(board_ids: $boardIds, limit: $limit, page: $page) { id body created_at edited_at kind creator { id name email } } }

notification.create.title: Create Notification
notification.create.description: Send a notification with the create_notification mutation. text, userId, targetId, and targetType are required. targetType is NotificationTargetType: Post (update/reply) or Project (item/board).

body.query: mutation ($text: String!, $userId: ID!, $targetId: ID!, $targetType: NotificationTargetType!) { create_notification(text: $text, user_id: $userId, target_id: $targetId, target_type: $targetType) { text } }

tags.list.title: Get Tags
tags.list.description: List tags with the tags(ids:) query. Optional ids filters to specific tags.

body.query: query ($ids: [Int]) { tags(ids: $ids) { id name color } }

tag.create.title: Create Tag
tag.create.description: Create or return an existing tag with the create_or_get_tag mutation. tagName is required. Pass boardId to create a private board tag; omit it for a public tag.

boardId.description: Board ID for a private tag.

body.query: mutation ($tagName: String!, $boardId: ID) { create_or_get_tag(tag_name: $tagName, board_id: $boardId) { id name color } }

tag.get.title: Get Tag
tag.get.description: Fetch a tag by ID with tags(ids:). tagId is required. monday has no update-tag mutation; this is the documented way to retrieve tag details (Composio MONDAY_UPDATE_TAG is a get-or-create wrapper).

body.query: query ($ids: [Int]) { tags(ids: $ids) { id name color } }

folders.list.title: Get Folders
folders.list.description: List folders with the folders(workspace_ids, ids, limit, page) query. Optional workspaceIds scopes the list.

workspaceIds.description: Workspace IDs to list folders from.

body.query: query ($workspaceIds: [ID], $ids: [ID], $limit: Int, $page: Int) { folders(workspace_ids: $workspaceIds, ids: $ids, limit: $limit, page: $page) { id name color parent { id } children { id name } } }

folder.create.title: Create Folder
folder.create.description: Create a folder with the create_folder mutation. name is required. workspaceId places the folder; parentFolderId nests it; color is FolderColor.

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID to create the folder in.

parentFolderId.description: Parent folder ID for a nested folder.

color.description: FolderColor enum, e.g. DONE_GREEN, WORKING_ORANGE, SOFIA_PINK.

body.query: mutation ($name: String!, $workspaceId: ID, $parentFolderId: ID, $color: FolderColor) { create_folder(name: $name, workspace_id: $workspaceId, parent_folder_id: $parentFolderId, color: $color) { id name color } }

folder.update.title: Update Folder
folder.update.description: Update a folder with the update_folder mutation. folderId is required. Optional name, color, parentFolderId, accountProductId.

body.query: mutation ($folderId: ID!, $name: String, $color: FolderColor, $parentFolderId: ID, $accountProductId: ID) { update_folder(folder_id: $folderId, name: $name, color: $color, parent_folder_id: $parentFolderId, account_product_id: $accountProductId) { id name color } }

folder.delete.title: Delete Folder
folder.delete.description: Delete a folder with the delete_folder mutation. folderId is required.

body.query: mutation ($folderId: ID!) { delete_folder(folder_id: $folderId) { id } }

docs.list.title: Get Docs
docs.list.description: List docs with the docs(ids, object_ids, workspace_ids, limit, page, order_by) query. orderBy is DocsOrderBy created_at | used_at.

objectIds.description: Object IDs from the doc URL / doc column.

workspaceIds.description: Workspace IDs to list docs from.

body.query: query ($ids: [ID!], $objectIds: [ID!], $workspaceIds: [ID], $limit: Int, $page: Int, $orderBy: DocsOrderBy) { docs(ids: $ids, object_ids: $objectIds, workspace_ids: $workspaceIds, limit: $limit, page: $page, order_by: $orderBy) { id object_id name doc_kind created_at updated_at url relative_url doc_folder_id created_by { id name } } }

docs.create.title: Create Doc
docs.create.description: Create a doc with the create_doc mutation. location is required (CreateDocInput!): either { workspace: { workspace_id, name, kind } } or { board: { item_id, column_id } }.

location.description: CreateDocInput!. Required. workspace: { workspace_id, name, kind } or board: { item_id, column_id }.

body.query: mutation ($location: CreateDocInput!) { create_doc(location: $location) { id object_id name doc_kind url } }

docs.update.title: Update Doc Name
docs.update.description: Rename a doc with the update_doc_name mutation. docId and name are required.

body.query: mutation ($docId: ID!, $name: String!) { update_doc_name(docId: $docId, name: $name) }

docs.delete.title: Delete Doc
docs.delete.description: Delete a doc with the delete_doc mutation. docId is required.

body.query: mutation ($docId: ID!) { delete_doc(docId: $docId) }

docs.blocks.title: Get Document Blocks
docs.blocks.description: Retrieve document blocks nested under docs { blocks }. docIds is required. Optional limit/page paginate blocks per doc.

body.query: query ($docIds: [ID!]!, $limit: Int, $page: Int) { docs(ids: $docIds) { id name blocks(limit: $limit, page: $page) { id type content created_at } } }

docs.importHtml.title: Import Doc From HTML
docs.importHtml.description: Import HTML into a new monday doc with the import_doc_from_html mutation. html and workspaceId are required. Optional title, folderId, kind (private | public | share).

title.description: Document title. Inferred from HTML when omitted.

folderId.description: Folder ID to create the doc in.

body.query: mutation ($html: String!, $workspaceId: ID!, $title: String, $folderId: ID, $kind: BoardKind) { import_doc_from_html(html: $html, workspaceId: $workspaceId, title: $title, folderId: $folderId, kind: $kind) { success error doc_id } }

assets.get.title: Get Assets
assets.get.description: Retrieve assets by ID with the assets(ids:) query. ids is required.

body.query: query ($ids: [ID!]!) { assets(ids: $ids) { id name url public_url file_extension file_size created_at url_thumbnail uploaded_by { id name } } }

assets.clearColumn.title: Delete Asset From File Column
assets.clearColumn.description: Clear a file column (monday has no direct delete-asset mutation) with change_column_value, sending an empty JSON object. boardId, itemId, and columnId are required. This is the documented way to remove files from a File column (Composio MONDAY_DELETE_ASSET target=column).

value.description: JSON-ENCODED STRING to write. Defaults to {} to clear the column.

body.query: mutation ($boardId: ID!, $itemId: ID!, $columnId: String!, $value: JSON!) { change_column_value(board_id: $boardId, item_id: $itemId, column_id: $columnId, value: $value) { id name } }

webhooks.list.title: Get Webhooks
webhooks.list.description: List webhooks on a board with webhooks(board_id:). boardId is required.

body.query: query ($boardId: ID!) { webhooks(board_id: $boardId) { id event board_id config } }

dashboard.create.title: Create Dashboard
dashboard.create.description: Create a dashboard with the create_dashboard mutation. name, workspaceId, and boardIds are required. kind is DashboardKind PUBLIC | PRIVATE.

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID (ID!). Required. Use -1 for the main workspace.

boardFolderId.description: Folder ID to create the dashboard in.

body.query: mutation ($name: String!, $workspaceId: ID!, $boardIds: [ID!]!, $kind: DashboardKind, $boardFolderId: ID) { create_dashboard(name: $name, workspace_id: $workspaceId, board_ids: $boardIds, kind: $kind, board_folder_id: $boardFolderId) { id name workspace_id kind board_folder_id } }

dashboards.list.title: Query Dashboards
dashboards.list.description: List dashboards with the dashboards(limit:) query.

body.query: query ($limit: Int) { dashboards(limit: $limit) { id name workspace_id kind } }

favorites.list.title: Get Favorites
favorites.list.description: List the current user's favorites with query { favorites { id position object { id type } folderId createdAt updatedAt } }. Takes no input.

body.query: query { favorites { id position folderId createdAt updatedAt object { id type } } }

audit.list.title: Get Audit Logs
audit.list.description: Retrieve account audit logs with the audit_logs query (Enterprise; manage_account_security). Optional page, limit, events, userId, ipAddress, startTime, endTime.

events.description: Event type filters, e.g. login, logout.

body.query: query ($page: Int, $limit: Int, $events: [String!], $userId: ID, $ipAddress: String, $startTime: ISO8601DateTime, $endTime: ISO8601DateTime) { audit_logs(page: $page, limit: $limit, events: $events, user_id: $userId, ip_address: $ipAddress, start_time: $startTime, end_time: $endTime) { logs { timestamp account_id event slug ip_address user { id name email } } pagination { page page_size has_more_pages next_page_number } } }

form.get.title: Get Form
form.get.description: Retrieve a monday Workform by token with query form(formToken:). formToken is required.

body.query: query ($formToken: String!) { form(formToken: $formToken) { id token active title ownerId description type } }

timeline.list.title: Get Item Timeline
timeline.list.description: Read an item's Emails & Activities timeline with query timeline(id:). id is the item ID. Optional limit and cursor paginate timeline_items_page.

id.description: Item ID whose timeline to fetch (ID!). Required.

body.query: query ($id: ID!, $limit: Int, $cursor: String) { timeline(id: $id, limit: $limit, cursor: $cursor) { timeline_items_page { cursor } timeline_items { id title type content custom_activity_id created_at } } }

timeline.get.title: Get Timeline Item
timeline.get.description: Fetch a single E&A timeline item with query timeline_item(id:). id is required.

body.query: query ($id: ID!) { timeline_item(id: $id) { id title type content created_at custom_activity_id item { id name } board { id } user { id name } } }

timeline.create.title: Create Timeline Item
timeline.create.description: Create an E&A timeline item with the create_timeline_item mutation. itemId, customActivityId, title, and timestamp (ISO8601DateTime!) are required. Optional content, summary, url, phone, location, timeRange { start_timestamp, end_timestamp }.

itemId.description: Item ID to attach the timeline item to (ID!). Required.

body.query: mutation ($itemId: ID!, $customActivityId: String!, $title: String!, $timestamp: ISO8601DateTime!, $content: String, $summary: String, $url: String, $phone: String, $location: String, $timeRange: TimelineItemTimeRange) { create_timeline_item(item_id: $itemId, custom_activity_id: $customActivityId, title: $title, timestamp: $timestamp, content: $content, summary: $summary, url: $url, phone: $phone, location: $location, time_range: $timeRange) { id title type } }

timeline.delete.title: Delete Timeline Item
timeline.delete.description: Delete an E&A timeline item with the delete_timeline_item mutation. id is required.

body.query: mutation ($id: ID!) { delete_timeline_item(id: $id) { id } }

customActivity.list.title: Get Custom Activity
customActivity.list.description: List E&A custom activities with query { custom_activity { id name color icon_id } }. Returns up to 50. Takes no input.

body.query: query { custom_activity { id name color icon_id } }

customActivity.create.title: Create Custom Activity
customActivity.create.description: Create an E&A custom activity with the create_custom_activity mutation. name, color, and iconId are required. color is a CustomActivityColor enum (e.g. SLATE_BLUE). iconId is a CustomActivityIcon enum (e.g. TRIPOD).

body.query: mutation ($name: String!, $color: CustomActivityColor!, $iconId: CustomActivityIcon!) { create_custom_activity(name: $name, color: $color, icon_id: $iconId) { id name color icon_id } }

customActivity.delete.title: Delete Custom Activity
customActivity.delete.description: Delete an E&A custom activity with the delete_custom_activity mutation. id is required.

body.query: mutation ($id: ID!) { delete_custom_activity(id: $id) { id } }

webhook.column_created.title: Column Created
webhook.column_created.description: Fires when a column is created on a board.

webhook.item_archived.title: Item Archived
webhook.item_archived.description: Fires when an item is archived.

webhook.item_column_value_updated.title: Item Column Value Updated
webhook.item_column_value_updated.description: Fires when an item column value changes.

webhook.item_deleted.title: Item Deleted
webhook.item_deleted.description: Fires when an item is deleted.

webhook.item_moved_to_group.title: Item Moved To Group
webhook.item_moved_to_group.description: Fires when an item is moved to another group.

webhook.item_name_updated.title: Item Name Updated
webhook.item_name_updated.description: Fires when an item is renamed.

webhook.item_update_deleted.title: Item Update Deleted
webhook.item_update_deleted.description: Fires when an item update/comment is deleted.

webhook.item_update_edited.title: Item Update Edited
webhook.item_update_edited.description: Fires when an item update/comment is edited.

webhook.item_update_posted.title: Item Update Posted
webhook.item_update_posted.description: Fires when an item update/comment is posted.

webhook.item_update_reply_posted.title: Item Update Reply Posted
webhook.item_update_reply_posted.description: Fires when a reply is posted on an item update.

webhook.subitem_archived.title: Subitem Archived
webhook.subitem_archived.description: Fires when a subitem is archived.

webhook.subitem_column_value_updated.title: Subitem Column Value Updated
webhook.subitem_column_value_updated.description: Fires when a subitem column value changes.

webhook.subitem_created.title: Subitem Created
webhook.subitem_created.description: Fires when a subitem is created.

webhook.subitem_deleted.title: Subitem Deleted
webhook.subitem_deleted.description: Fires when a subitem is deleted.

webhook.subitem_name_updated.title: Subitem Name Updated
webhook.subitem_name_updated.description: Fires when a subitem is renamed.

webhook.subitem_update_posted.title: Subitem Update Posted
webhook.subitem_update_posted.description: Fires when an update is posted on a subitem.
